preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
For each test case, the length of the permutation N must be between 3 and 100,000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if N < 4 else len(stdout.split()) == N
postconditions.description: If N is less than 4, output -1; otherwise, output a permutation of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) ^ int(stdout.split()[i+1]) != int(stdout.split()[i+2]) for i in range(N-2))
postconditions.description: For each valid permutation, the XOR of adjacent elements must not equal the next element.
